products.name: TalkingPoints
products.note: AI: Translation in 100+ languages (human plus machine, per vendor). Who: Teachers, administrators, families. Student age: Family-facing; no student accounts needed. Privacy: Paid school and district version syncs contacts from the student information system; Common Sense privacy rating not yet published. Price: Free for teachers in the US and Canada; paid school and district plans (free tier reported as up to 200 students and 5 classes by a third party).
